video_title: The Chicago Bulls are finalizing a deal with Tiago Splitter to be the next head coach 🚨 | NBA Today

quotes.speaker: Shams Charania
quotes.summary_phrase: Tiago Splitter hired as new Chicago Bulls head coach
quotes.excerpt: the Bulls have reached a deal to hire Tiago Splitter as the franchise's next head coach
quotes.quote: The Bulls have reached a deal to hire Tiago Splitter as the franchise's next head coach. This comes after Splitter thrived as an interim coach, excelled in his lone season as head coach of the Portland Trail Blazers after navigating an adverse situation, taking over just after one game due to the FBI arrest of Chauncey Billups. Splitter led the Blazers to a 42-40 record, the number seven seed, and a playoff berth. A couple of key factors in the Bulls' hiring of Splitter: his player development, such as a guy like Deni Avdija in Portland, and the job that he did pushing him to be an All-Star, as well as an organizational alignment with the new head of basketball operations in Bryson Graham.

quotes.speaker: Bobby Marks
quotes.summary_phrase: NBA summer priorities include extensions, LeBron James, and Giannis Antetokounmpo
quotes.excerpt: this is the summer of extensions. This is a historic group
quotes.quote: This is the summer of extensions. This is a historic group when you are looking at Nikola Jokic, Kawhi Leonard, Karl-Anthony Towns, Donovan Mitchell. Stephen Curry is extension eligible in August. Certainly, we have talked Jaylen Brown, of course. There is 20 players that are All-NBA All-Star level that are extension eligible. Number two is LeBron James. What will happen with LeBron James in Los Angeles as he returns? How much cap space is left to fill out that roster if James comes in at a 25 to 30 million dollar number? And of course, number one, which we are all waiting on, what will happen with Giannis Antetokounmpo in Milwaukee.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Milwaukee Bucks are carefully evaluating trade offers for Giannis Antetokounmpo
quotes.excerpt: The Bucks are trying to draw out everyone's best offer.
quotes.quote: The Bucks are trying to draw out everyone's best offer. There has been a lot of discussions, but everyone is cognizant of other people maybe offering other packages and nobody wants to bid against themselves. Obviously, Miami and the Bucks have been in talks on and off for months about this. They haven't been able to consummate a deal. Giannis Antetokounmpo has expressed an interest in extending his contract in Miami, which is why Miami has been so interested in doing it. But Boston is also out there because Giannis Antetokounmpo, from what I am told, is willing to extend his contract in Boston.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Boston Celtics face challenges integrating Giannis Antetokounmpo into their system
quotes.excerpt: If you are going to entertain trading for Giannis, you are talking about changing your entire style.
quotes.quote: But when you get to Boston, you have to understand there is two enormously important things. Number one, what it would take to get Giannis Antetokounmpo in a trade. I think the Celtics are going to be very, very cautious with making any firm offer. Second thing is, if you are going to entertain trading for Giannis Antetokounmpo, you are talking about changing your entire style of play in Boston, and Joe Mazzulla has pretty much been dogmatic in how he wants to play.

quotes.speaker: Richard Jefferson
quotes.summary_phrase: Giannis Antetokounmpo provides necessary rim pressure for the Boston Celtics
quotes.excerpt: Giannis, being able to put pressure on the rim, that helps you a lot.
quotes.quote: I think Boston is the best place for him, honestly. I know that you talk about Joe Mazzulla's system and his offense, this might be what it needs. They need to change, it might force him to change because they shoot a lot of threes, they are a lot of drive-kick-swing, which has been fruitful and successful in moments, but it is hard to win championships when you live and die by the three. So Giannis Antetokounmpo, being able to put pressure on the rim, get to the free throw line, lead the league in dunks probably in history, that helps you a lot.

quotes.speaker: Bobby Marks
quotes.summary_phrase: Jaylen Brown is the key to a potential Giannis trade
quotes.excerpt: if you are going to put Jaylen Brown's name out there, you better be awfully careful
quotes.quote: It would have to be certainly Jaylen Brown, who has three years left on his contract. And as Brian said, if you are going to put Jaylen Brown's name out there, you better be awfully careful as far as if something does not materialize here. Now the big question is if Brown is involved, what does Milwaukee do with Jaylen Brown? Do they use him in another trade? Do they keep? Do they build around here? So I think if you are talking Celtics trade packages, it certainly starts with Jaylen Brown.
